reason: Root read Kim, Choi and Lee, Construction of reversible self-dual codes, Finite Fields Appl. 67 (2020) 101714 (author-hosted PDF, body lines 150-166 and 724-760): Aut(C) is the full coordinate-permutation stabilizer; reversible codes of length 2n contain tau = (1,2n)(2,2n-1)...(n,n+1), which is fixed-point-free; Theorem 5.1 gives nine [70,35,12] reversible self-dual codes whose automorphism groups have order two. Hence PAut(C) = <tau> ≅ C2 acting freely, a binary quasi group code of length 70, contradicting Conjecture 4.9 (posed July 2022). The [12,6,3] code, its Lean certificate and the length-10 minimality computation are correct but resolve an already-refuted conjecture; minimal-length refinement is a parameter variant. Retained as historical evidence.
